# AIO Growth SEO
## Local SEO and GEO agency — Daytona Beach, Florida

AIO Growth SEO is a local SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency based in Daytona Beach, FL. We help service businesses in Volusia County, Flagler County, and Central Florida get found in Google Search, Google Maps, and AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude.

Owner: Joel Hinton
Location: Daytona Beach, FL 32114
Phone: (386) 222-2932
Email: info@aiogrowthseo.com

## About
Joel Hinton founded AIO Growth SEO to bring AI-era SEO to local service businesses in Volusia and Flagler Counties before national agencies figured out the local angle. The agency specializes in the intersection of local SEO and GEO — getting businesses found in both traditional search and AI-generated recommendations.
